headline: Kapros on Mega News 104.6: “There is no risk of Europe running out of energy” – Why natural gas storage facilities are not filling
summary: Energy economics professor Pantelis Kapros said there is no risk of Europe running out of energy. He was commenting on why natural gas storage facilities are not filling.
why: Natural gas storage levels influence European gas prices and the security of winter energy supply.
